plugins.name: budget-analyzer
plugins.description: Analyze supplier and contractor quotes to derive per-unit budget averages for each D-One system.

plugins.name: component-schedule
plugins.description: Generate a D-One branded Component & Equipment Schedule PDF from a project quote.

plugins.name: conduit-schedule
plugins.description: Generate a D-One branded Conduit Schedule Excel from a project quote or annotated floorplan.

plugins.name: d-one-lead-filter
plugins.description: Qualify a new D-One lead through eight gates to a Pursue / Caution / Decline verdict, with respectful decline drafts.

plugins.name: d-one-proposal
plugins.description: Generate an interactive, client-facing D-One home technology proposal and publish it as a hosted link.

plugins.name: d-one-technical-file
plugins.description: D-One Technical File Generator: automates component schedule, conduit schedule, and wiring diagram generation from a WeQuote PDF.

plugins.name: estimator
plugins.description: Build a detailed, itemised D-One quote (equipment + labour) as an editable Excel spreadsheet, priced live from Odoo, organised by Room/Area. Regenerates an Odoo Sales Order import from the edited Excel (into the native Room field), can add new items to the Odoo pricelist, and can import the confirmed quote into Odoo as a draft..

plugins.name: floorplan-icons
plugins.description: Place D-One AV/tech icons onto a PDF floorplan to produce a branded equipment layout.

plugins.name: floorplan-takeoff
plugins.description: Generate a component quantities spreadsheet from an annotated floor plan PDF.

plugins.name: lighting-takeoff
plugins.description: Count lighting items off an electrical/lighting layout floorplan PDF and produce a per-floor quantity spreadsheet.

plugins.name: wequote-budget
plugins.description: Build accurate Entry/Mid/Premium budgets for D-One proposals from floorplan icon counts, a WeQuote URL, or manual quantities.

plugins.name: linking-a-po
plugins.description: Link a manually-created Purchase Order in Odoo to its originating Sales Order/quote, so it shows up alongside the other POs generated from that quote.
